L514: ### 3.2 Centroaffine polygon recutting
L515: 
L516: As mentioned in Introduction, by the elementary recutting of a closed polygon ${\bf P}$ we mean the linear transformation that changes only one vertex: $P^{\prime}_{j}=R_{P_{j-1}P_{j+1}}(P_{j})$. Denote this transformation by $\mathsf{R}_{j}$. Elementary recutings are involutions. The recutting $\mathsf{R}$ of the polygon $\bf P$ is the composition $\mathsf{R}_{n}\circ\cdots\circ\mathsf{R}_{1}$.
L517: 
L518: The next lemma is a centroaffine analog of [cite39†2 , Cor. 2].
L519: ###### Lemma 3.4.
L520:
